newsitem.title: USA: Peru's Credicorp to boost loan volume.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Credicorp to boost loan volume.

text.p: Peru's Credicorp Ltd plans to increase its loans volume by focusing on mortgages, credit cards and small companies, among other markets, the bank's chief operating officer said Friday.
Raimundo Morales told a conference call that the country's largest provider of financial services was preparing to enter those markets during the second half of the year.
"The quality of the loan portfolio should improve by year end," he said, adding that car loans and medium-sized companies were other markets that the bank was considering.
He said the bank also planned to boost its physical presence in the country by opening more branches and installing more automatic teller machines.
He said it was preparing to open its first mini-branch at a gas station within the next two weeks as part of a project with U.S. oil giant Mobil Corp.
"If that kind of project works out very well, we will probably be opening a much larger number of branches in gas stations (elsewhere)," he said.
Credicorp had a net interest income of $101.8 million for the second quarter against $82.2 million for the same period a year ago.
The bank's American Depositary Receipt (ADR) closed 3/16 higher at 20-9/16 on the New York Stock Exchange.
